_comment: Who actually sat in a seat, when it changed hands mid-tournament (PROTOCOL.md §11.6).
Copy to substitutes.json only if it happens; most events never need this file.
A seat in this event is a local_id, not a person. The template position, the deficient
wind, the opponents and the Pantheon prescript are all written in local ids. Under the
frozen policy final_round.substitutes = "same_registration", the substitute plays on
the seat's existing Pantheon registration, so Mimir still reports one row per seat with
a full eleven games and NOTHING about the final draw changes.
That is why this file is not frozen and may be written late: it cannot move a table.
It is the honest record that the name on the seat is not the person who played it.
tools/lock-final.js copies it into events/final/lock.json, so it is covered by the same
digest and the same timestamp as the standings.
